headline: Security forces kill Lashkar’s last known local militant in Kulgam
summary: A joint Army and police operation on Wednesday killed Lashkar operative Lateef Bhat, 22, after he refused to surrender inside a Kulgam mosque. Carrying a ₹15 lakh reward, Bhat had attacked CRPF personnel on November 11. Amit Shah called him Lashkar’s last known local militant in the Valley.
why_it_matters: Eliminating the last known local Lashkar fighter removes a key recruiter and operational link for cross-border handlers targeting tourism and workers in southern Kashmir.
source_search: Security forces kill Lashkar’s last known local militant in Kulgam The Hindu

headline: Bahrain and Kuwait intercept Iranian strikes after U.S. hits Qeshm Island
summary: Bahrain and Kuwait intercepted Iranian aerial attacks on Wednesday after U.S. fighter jets struck an Iranian Revolutionary Guard missile site on Qeshm Island. Iran said its drones targeted American radar and Patriot systems at regional bases. Separately, a Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile launched toward Riyadh.
why_it_matters: Escalating tit-for-tat strikes around the Strait of Hormuz threaten Gulf energy security and raise the risk of wider civilian disruption across U.S.-allied Arab states.
source_search: Bahrain and Kuwait intercept Iranian strikes after U.S. hits Qeshm Island The Hindu

headline: Delhi Police closes journalists' assault complaints from Election Commission protests
summary: Delhi Police told the Supreme Court it closed sexual assault complaints by three women journalists covering October protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Police said two journalists dropped complaints, one skipped the inquiry, CCTV showed no assault, and Supreme Court journalist protections exclude social media influencers.
why_it_matters: The police filing tests judicial limits on crowd-control accountability and narrows who qualifies for press protections during street protests in India.
source_search: Delhi Police closes journalists' assault complaints from Election Commission protests Scroll.in

headline: Xi pitches China as open-trade partner at APEC amid U.S. tariff push
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping urged business leaders at Shenzhen’s APEC summit on Wednesday to defend open trade and resist protectionism. Contrasting Beijing with Washington’s tariffs, Xi pledged duty cuts and wider market access ahead of meetings with Donald Trump and a trilateral summit with Vladimir Putin.
why_it_matters: China’s push to lead multilateral trade and technology partnerships could win influence across Global South economies alienated by U.S. tariffs and export controls.
source_search: Xi pitches China as open-trade partner at APEC amid U.S. tariff push Al Jazeera

headline: Indian crew member missing, two injured after Strait of Hormuz tanker attack
summary: One Indian national is missing and two are hospitalised after an attack on the Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT Tara Gas in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. India’s External Affairs Ministry said 21 of the 24 Indians aboard were evacuated to Khasab, Oman, as search operations continue.
why_it_matters: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz directly endanger Indian seafarers and threaten vital energy and trade corridors supplying India’s economy.
source_search: Indian crew member missing, two injured after Strait of Hormuz tanker attack The Hindu

headline: Nvidia halts China H200 chip sales after U.S. closes loophole
summary: Acting CEO Colette Kress announced Tuesday that Nvidia will stop selling H200 chips in China, ending a tariffed export arrangement. The exit follows Monday's U.S. rules barring advanced chips from foreign data centres serving Chinese clients, though Kress expects Vera Rubin backlogs to offset lost revenue.
why_it_matters: Cutting off remote overseas compute closes a major backdoor for Chinese AI labs, accelerating Beijing's push toward domestic semiconductors while reshaping global cloud demand.
source_search: Nvidia halts China H200 chip sales after U.S. closes loophole TechCrunch

headline: Delhi court orders charges against 14 accused in NEET paper leak case
summary: A Delhi court on Wednesday ordered framing of charges against 14 accused in the NEET paper leak case, scheduling daily hearings from November 25. Special Judge Ajay Gupta invoked conspiracy, corruption, and public examination laws after CBI probes into the cancelled May medical test and June re-examination.
why_it_matters: Fast-tracking the trial under the new anti-cheating law tests India’s ability to deter organised exam fraud affecting millions of medical and university aspirants.
source_search: Delhi court orders charges against 14 accused in NEET paper leak case The Hindu

headline: Israeli Parliament elects opposition-backed Matan Kahana as new Knesset Speaker
summary: Israel’s parliament voted 66 to 52 on Tuesday to elect Matan Kahana as Knesset Speaker, replacing a Benjamin Netanyahu ally. Backed by Jewish and Arab opposition parties, Kahana gives rival leader Gadi Eisenkot legislative control to advance bills imposing prime ministerial term limits and reversing judicial curbs.
why_it_matters: Controlling the speaker’s agenda lets Israel’s anti-Netanyahu bloc fast-track institutional reforms and an October 7 inquiry even while coalition negotiations continue.
source_search: Israeli Parliament elects opposition-backed Matan Kahana as new Knesset Speaker The Hindu

headline: Microsoft embeds Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly inside Copilot
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced Tuesday at Ignite that Word, Excel, and PowerPoint are now generally available inside Copilot. Alongside the shift, Microsoft launched its Work IQ context layer and Copilot Autopilot, an autonomous cloud agent authorized to complete delegated tasks across company emails, calendars, and internal files.
why_it_matters: Turning Office apps into background plugins for AI agents marks a major enterprise workflow shift, forcing IT teams to weigh productivity gains against data permissions.
source_search: Microsoft embeds Word, Excel, and PowerPoint directly inside Copilot Ars Technica

headline: India weighs halving stock transaction tax while raising derivatives levies
summary: Indian revenue officials are reviewing proposals to cut the securities transaction tax on stock trades by 50% while raising derivatives taxes ahead of February's Budget. Submissions for Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman also weigh lowering capital gains levies after retail traders lost ₹917 billion in derivatives last fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Shifting tax incentives from leveraged options back toward cash equities could protect retail household wealth and deepen long-term capital formation in Indian markets.
source_search: India weighs halving stock transaction tax while raising derivatives levies Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Allahabad High Court grants Azam Khan bail, rebukes Enforcement Directorate
summary: The Allahabad High Court granted interim bail to former Uttar Pradesh minister Azam Khan in a money laundering case, calling his October 31 arrest motivated for lacking written grounds. On Wednesday, the Supreme Court refused the Enforcement Directorate's request to urgently halt Khan's relief before Thursday's hearing.
why_it_matters: Judicial scrutiny over procedural lapses in Enforcement Directorate arrests reinforces constitutional safeguards against arbitrary detention ahead of next year's Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections.
source_search: Allahabad High Court grants Azam Khan bail, rebukes Enforcement Directorate Scroll.in

headline: Rubio sees zero evidence linking U.S. tech and agency outages to cyberattacks
summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Tuesday there is zero evidence linking recent service outages at Microsoft, Chase Bank, air traffic control, and the NSA to hackers or foreign adversaries. National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton blamed the disruptions on unexpected hiccups during security upgrades.
why_it_matters: Even without malicious hacking, simultaneous failures across banking, aviation, and intelligence networks expose how fragile critical infrastructure has become during hurried software patching.
source_search: Rubio sees zero evidence linking U.S. tech and agency outages to cyberattacks The Hindu

headline: Nvidia refuses to reinstate Jensen Huang as quarterly sales top $115 billion
summary: Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones ruled out reinstating ousted cofounder Jensen Huang on Tuesday, even as quarterly sales doubled to $115.8 billion. Interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia halted Hopper chip shipments to China and projected 13% revenue growth next quarter, lifting shares 4.8% in extended trading.
why_it_matters: Surging data-centre demand reassures investors that global artificial intelligence spending remains intact despite governance turmoil following Huang’s resignation over a China-linked scandal.
source_search: Nvidia refuses to reinstate Jensen Huang as quarterly sales top $115 billion BBC

headline: Democrats win Alaska Senate race to clinch 56-seat majority
summary: Democrat Mary Peltola won Alaska’s Senate race two weeks after November 3, expanding the Democratic majority to 56 seats. Peltola unseated Republican Dan Sullivan despite an alleged spoiler dispute and a dismissed lawsuit. Having also retaken the House, Democrats will control Congress for Trump’s final two years.
why_it_matters: Full Democratic control of Congress gives lawmakers leverage to block White House legislation, reshape spending, and scrutinise administration policies over the next two years.
source_search: Democrats win Alaska Senate race to clinch 56-seat majority BBC

headline: SEBI chief rules out round-the-clock stock trading and equity tokenisation
summary: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said Wednesday in Mumbai that India has no immediate plans for 24x7 stock trading, citing cybersecurity threats and fragmented liquidity. At the World Federation of Exchanges meeting, he also called equity tokenisation unviable at India's scale and flagged hurdles for overseas dual listings.
why_it_matters: Prioritising market stability and client-level account tracking over continuous trading signals that Indian regulators are cautious about adopting high-cost global market experiments prematurely.
source_search: SEBI chief rules out round-the-clock stock trading and equity tokenisation Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Global film figures rally against Iran's five-year sentence for Jafar Panahi
summary: Over 200 filmmakers, actors, and festival directors, including Mark Ruffalo, Tilda Swinton, and Barry Jenkins, condemned Tehran's five years and one month sentence against Jafar Panahi. After returning to Iran in March, the Cannes winner now faces frozen bank accounts, asset confiscation, and travel and social media bans.
why_it_matters: Harsher penalties against an internationally acclaimed director signal intensifying state pressure on Iranian artists who refuse exile and continue working inside the country.
source_search: Global film figures rally against Iran's five-year sentence for Jafar Panahi Variety

headline: Britain launches 300,000-youth study ahead of under-16 social media ban
summary: Health charity Wellcome Trust is funding ten UK research projects tracking over 300,000 young people to measure how Britain's upcoming under-16 social media ban affects mental health. Using wearables, surveys, and digital diaries before spring 2027, researchers will monitor screen habits, wellbeing, and ban workarounds across diverse groups.
why_it_matters: Longitudinal data collected before and after the ban will give UK and global policymakers rare empirical evidence on whether platform age restrictions genuinely improve adolescent wellbeing.
source_search: Britain launches 300,000-youth study ahead of under-16 social media ban BBC

headline: Centre issues district ombudsperson rules for VB-G RAM G rural job scheme
summary: The Rural Development Ministry on Wednesday issued district ombudsperson guidelines under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, which replaced MGNREGA in July. Ombudspersons will resolve wage, job card, and harassment complaints through a digital portal, geotagged field checks, and at least three monthly gram sabha hearings.
why_it_matters: Independent local redressal and mandatory social audits could curb delayed wage payments and muster-roll fraud as India transitions away from MGNREGA.
source_search: Centre issues district ombudsperson rules for VB-G RAM G rural job scheme The Hindu

headline: U.S. court sentences Pakistani man to 27 years for Iran-backed Trump plot
summary: A Brooklyn federal judge on Tuesday sentenced Pakistani national Asif Merchant, 48, to 330 months in prison for plotting with Iran’s Revolutionary Guard to assassinate Donald Trump, Joe Biden, and Nikki Haley in 2024. Federal agents foiled the scheme after a recruit reported Merchant to authorities.
why_it_matters: The sentencing closes a high-profile transnational terrorism case that preceded this year’s U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, while Tehran continues denying involvement.
source_search: U.S. court sentences Pakistani man to 27 years for Iran-backed Trump plot The Hindu

headline: Optimizely breach injects payment-stealing malware across 178 major websites
summary: Hackers compromised digital experience platform Optimizely to inject malicious JavaScript across 178 organisations, including Zoom, BBC, CNN, HSBC, and IKEA. Detected November 16 by Report URI, the code targeted cryptocurrency wallets, payment cards, and browser cookies, and carried iOS exploit kits. Optimizely said it has remediated the flaw.
why_it_matters: Supply-chain breaches in third-party marketing and testing scripts let attackers bypass a website's own defences, silently exposing millions of unsuspecting visitors to financial theft.
source_search: Optimizely breach injects payment-stealing malware across 178 major websites Inc42

headline: Reform UK councils fail to deliver promised Doge-style spending cuts
summary: Research by Public First Global shows six Reform UK-run English county councils achieved just £30 million to £44 million in genuine discretionary cuts, matching comparable authorities. Despite Nigel Farage's Doge-style pledges, the councils declared no savings from scrapping net zero or diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
why_it_matters: The gap between anti-waste campaign rhetoric and municipal budget realities weakens Reform UK's pitch as a fiscally disruptive governing alternative ahead of future British elections.
source_search: Reform UK councils fail to deliver promised Doge-style spending cuts The Guardian

headline: Gold and silver drop to one-year lows on strong dollar
summary: Indian gold and silver prices fell to one-year lows Wednesday, tracking a 14-month global slide as a stronger U.S. dollar pressured bullion. Pure gold opened at ₹1,31,505 per 10 grams and silver at ₹1,64,506 per kilogram, extending drops of 30% and 62% since January peaks.
why_it_matters: Sharp bullion corrections alongside rising U.S. interest rate bets could revive staggered Indian wedding-season jewellery demand while testing investor appetite for precious metals as safe havens.
source_search: Gold and silver drop to one-year lows on strong dollar Hindu BusinessLine

headline: Former three-weight boxing champion Jorge Linares detained by US immigration
summary: US immigration officers detained retired three-weight boxing champion Jorge Linares at El Paso International Airport on Sunday, placing the 41-year-old Venezuelan in Texas custody pending deportation. Authorities allege Linares overstayed his October 2023 entry permission, while his lawyers maintain he is authorized to stay and are working with ICE.
why_it_matters: The high-profile detention reflects stricter US immigration enforcement that leaves even Miami-based former champions with pending authorization applications vulnerable to removal.
source_search: Former three-weight boxing champion Jorge Linares detained by US immigration BBC Sport

headline: Tabu joins Netflix rescue drama Tunnel Men in first Hindi series
summary: Indian actor Tabu will star in Netflix's fictionalized rescue drama Tunnel Men, marking her first original Hindi-language streaming series. Produced by Yash Raj Films' YRF Entertainment and showrun by Shiv Rawail, the project draws on the November 2023 Uttarakhand tunnel collapse that left workers trapped underground.
why_it_matters: Landing a major film star alongside The Railway Men's showrunner deepens YRF Entertainment and Netflix's push into prestige Indian disaster dramas.
source_search: Tabu joins Netflix rescue drama Tunnel Men in first Hindi series Variety

headline: UK watchdog bans Voy adverts over misleading low testosterone claims
summary: Britain's Advertising Standards Authority banned five adverts by online provider Voy for making unsubstantiated low testosterone claims. Regulators ruled the posters and Facebook ads misleadingly linked fatigue and irritability to low testosterone and lacked evidence for claiming the condition affects one in four men over 30.
why_it_matters: Following similar rulings against two competitors in August, the ban signals tighter UK regulatory scrutiny of direct-to-consumer clinics exploiting men's ageing and health anxieties.
source_search: UK watchdog bans Voy adverts over misleading low testosterone claims BBC
